executiveSummary: Overall OT Cyber Threat Level: HIGH Multiple high-risk, OT-relevant advisories and active exploitation reports require immediate attention across energy, water/wastewater, transportation, and manufacturing environments. Pre-authentication gateway RCEs, perimeter device compromises, and direct PLC targeting elevate the likelihood of IT-to-OT pivot and potential process disruption over the next 72 hours. Direct PLC targeting: US agencies report active, AI-assisted exploitation attempts against Siemens S7 PLC families (S7-200/300/400/1200/1500); immediate removal of internet exposure and S7comm monitoring is advised. Security Advisory Iranian-affiliated actors have exploited internet-exposed PLCs from Rockwell, Schneider, and Siemens, manipulating logic and HMIs; several incidents caused operational disruption. Security Advisory NetScaler ADC/Gateway pre-auth RCE (CVE-2026-8452) with public PoC threatens remote access perimeters used by many CI operators-patch/harden now and hunt for web shells. Security Advisory MikroTik RouterOS exploited ("MikroTrick") for unauthenticated SSH and full device takeover; patch to fixed long-term/stable versions, restrict management, and audit for rogue users/scripts. Security Advisory Hitachi Energy FACTS Control Platform (FCP) vulnerabilities in grid stability systems (STATCOM/SVC, series capacitors) could enable remote manipulation; isolate/segment and apply vendor mitigations. ICS Advisory Active exploitation on Linux kernels (KEV) and exploited Cisco ISE NAC flaw reinforce urgency to patch core platforms that mediate identity and edge control. Alert View Article

relevance: Highest immediate OT risk vectors: internet-exposed PLCs/HMIs, pre-auth gateway RCEs (NetScaler), and exploited perimeter routers (MikroTik) that enable rapid IT-to-OT pivots. Energy grid exposure: Hitachi Energy FACTS Control Platform vulnerabilities could affect voltage/reactive power if reachable. Transportation: EV charging (EVbee/Autel) and rail detection (Frauscher) vulnerabilities increase likelihood of localized service impact if unsegmented. Sector targeting: Water/Wastewater and Energy face persistent hacktivist/state activity against HMIs/PLCs and weak remote access services.

items: NetScaler ADC/Gateway pre-auth RCE (CVE-2026-8452): patch now; hunt for web shells. Security Advisory
Cisco ISE critical flaw under active exploitation (CVE-2026-76460): restrict management plane; reimage if compromised. View Article
MikroTik RouterOS KEV additions (active exploitation): patch and remove WAN management exposure. Alert
Linux kernel (multiple KEV CVEs): prioritize kernel updates/live-patch on gateways/servers. Alert
Hitachi Energy FACTS Control Platform (FCP) GWS: auth bypass, traversal, query injection-segment and apply mitigations. ICS Advisory
Eclipse Milo (OPC UA) authorization bypass/DoS across versions-update stacks and harden endpoint policies. Vuln Summary
EV charging (EVbee/Autel) and railway detection (Frauscher) flaws-restrict OCPP/brokers, enforce TLS/mTLS, patch firmware. Vuln Summary Vuln Summary

descriptions: Initial access via perimeter devices (T1190), exploitation of public-facing applications and pre-auth RCE on gateways.
Valid accounts and LOTL: VPN credential abuse, Impacket lateral movement (T1021), WinRM/PowerShell (T1059), GPO/GPT manipulation.
Protocol abuse: S7comm unauthorized PUT/GET; ENIP/Modbus logic downloads; VNC brute force and HMI tampering.
Exfiltration via cloud storage and DNS/HTTPS covert channels; MQTT/Matrix C2 over commonly allowed egress.

outlook72h: Expect opportunistic probing of NetScaler ADC and MikroTik infrastructure to continue; complete patching and access restrictions within 72 hours. Increase detections for S7comm/ENIP mode changes and off-hours PLC write attempts; conduct targeted hunts on internet-exposed asset inventory. Validate backup/restoration for HMI/PLC projects and domain controllers; prepare containment steps for ransomware or policy-abuse scenarios. Engage vendors for ICS patch windows (Hitachi Energy FCP, OPC UA stacks) and deploy interim network compensating controls where patching is deferred.
